name: tutorial-not-on-other-levels
description: Issue #1319: the guided tutorial only runs on tutorial_pit. A first-time player (fresh storage, bs_tutorial_done unset) starts Dusty Hollow (menu New Campaign is Coming soon, #2276). The loading screen clears, the HUD is usable and no tutorial card is on screen. Before the fix the tutorial auto-started on whichever level a first-timer entered first and covered the HUD on a map it was not written for. Command mode only proves the level loads; the card is a DOM claim checked in interaction mode.

steps.description: Fresh page: the main menu is up, no loading overlay and no tutorial card.
A base game must exist before a campaign level can start.

Start Dusty Hollow through the console (menu New Campaign is Coming soon, #2276). Wait for the loading overlay to clear and the HUD to become reachable. The tutorial card must stay hidden: it is a first-time-player aid for tutorial_pit only.

expect.note: Dusty Hollow's own 96x96 terrain is loaded, the HUD Saves button is reachable (nothing covers it) and the tutorial card is hidden

steps.description: Tutorial card must still be absent on the live level: expect.blocked on #bs-tutorial-overlay fails unless the probe reports it absent or hidden.
